title: Patroni: process-kill + auto-rejoin
description: Runs `nexus chaos postgres process-kill`: kills nexus-patroni on a replica, observes impact, restarts it, and waits for the cluster to return to green.

observe.what: nexus-patroni killed on a replica; cluster recovers to GREEN (Patroni rejoin)

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync injects a process-kill via the embedded nexus-chaos.sh and proves Patroni self-heals the replica back to streaming.
